latest_version_code.description: Integer Android versionCode of the newest APK release.

latest_version_name.description: Human-readable version name displayed to users (e.g. 1.0.2).

apk_download_url.description: Direct HTTPS GitHub Releases .apk asset URL.

apk_sha256.description: Optional lowercase 64-char SHA-256 digest of the official release APK.

release_notes.description: Changelog displayed in the in-app update dialog.

update_enabled.description: Master switch to enable or pause in-app update prompts.

minimum_version_code.description: Versions strictly below this build number see a mandatory update screen.
